title: Hybrid Intelligence
visual_prompt: An abstract 8k visualization of 'Hybrid Intelligence'. A brain-like neural network (Local AI/Ollama) is connected by glowing data-filaments to a sleek laptop. The filaments pulse with golden light, representing 'Auto-Memory' and 'SLTM Search'. The environment is a clean, minimalist home office at dusk, with soft bokeh from the city lights outside. The feeling is one of calm, powerful augmentation.
camera_movement: Crane shot starting from the laptop, rising up into the pulsing neural network above, then circling it once to show the complex interconnections.
sound_design: Uplifting, organic ambient synth pad. Deep, pulsing bass that feels like a 'heartbeat' of intelligence. Whispers of digital data moving through the air.
